rule: The agent may state a claim only if it appears here. Anything absent is answered with 'I do not know, I will ask Denis' — never filled in. Every claim carries the level at which it is evidenced and the artefact where a listener can check it.

levels.L1: formally proven or arithmetically derived; machine-checked in CI
levels.L2: measured on reference hardware; raw traces not yet published
levels.policy: a chosen limit, not a measurement
levels.live: read from a published payload that refreshes
